title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
abstract: arXiv:2611.24757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. translated_title: 面向样本高效在线A/B测试的方差最优反事实策略设计
translated_abstract: 在线A/B测试是在部署前评估面向用户系统变更（例如新的推荐或排序策略）的标准方法。虽然标准A/B测试的均值差估计量是无偏的，但它通常存在高方差问题。当处理策略与生产策略以相近的概率选择相同的动作时，由此产生的观测数据会增加噪声，却几乎不提供关于两种策略差异的信息。因此，A/B测试往往需要大量流量和较长周期才能检测到较小的处理效应。现有的方差缩减方法主要是在数据收集方案固定之后改进估计量，而近年来的重叠感知设计仅优化两种策略之间的单一流量分配，因而无法将流量引导到两种策略不一致的动作上。在本文中，我们联合优化动作的采样方式……
tldr: 该论文提出一种方差最优的反事实策略设计方法，通过联合优化动作的采样方式，将流量引导至两种策略不一致的动作上，从而显著降低在线A/B测试的方差并提升样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variance-optimal counterfactual policy design that jointly optimizes how actions are sampled, directing traffic to actions on which the two policies disagree, thereby substantially reducing variance and improving sample efficiency in online A/B testing.
